title: Subida de nivel: la victoria se toma su tiempo
description: docs/animas/README.md § Levels, docs/combat.md § Victoria. The fight tester (La Cebolla y los suyos, Gerard in Matemágico and Aitor in Papagato, both at level 1) jumps to «won-level»: enough EXP for both ánimas to reach level 2. A quick Enter, and a pad's B and A, right as the screen opens do nothing: with a level reached, Seguir stays dim and deaf. Each level stamps in with a sweep of light and its sound; then what each ánima learned takes the screen, one band per ánima (HABILIDADES NUEVAS, the two skills side by side, their names landing with a glint, rays turning behind), and only once it has all shown does Seguir light up.

steps.caption: The victory screen with levels coming: Enter, and a pad's B and A, pressed at once did nothing; Seguir stays dim
«¡NIVEL 2!» stamps in, the card flashes in its colour and a sweep of light crosses it
HABILIDADES NUEVAS · Matemágico · nivel 2 · Gerard: Análisis Parálisis and Ángulo exacto, each with what it does and its maná; the result steps back
Then Papagato's band, in its own colour and type: Zarpazos and Ronroneo de Yuki
Only once it has all shown does Seguir light up, with «Aprende …» left on each card
